newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK money rates end steady to firmer in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: HK money rates end steady to firmer in quiet trade.

text.p: Interbank rates closed steady to firmer in quiet trading with investors sidelined awaiting for the U.S. nonfarm payrolls due later on Friday, dealers said.
Overnight cash finished at 4-15/16 7/8 percent against 4-3/4 5/8 percent on Thursday. Three-month money was little changed at 5-3/4 5/8 percent.

"Short-dates are a bit tight on the recent keen demand on money for new stock issues," a Japanese bank dealer said. "But trading has been quiet with players covering their positions ahead of tonight's U.S. figure."
Government paper opened general lower on weaker U.S. treasuries but losses were trimmed in late trade on light buying, dealers said.

One week exchange fund bill yielded 4.98 and three month bill was 4.99 percent. The two-year exchange fund note yield was 5.98 percent while the 10-year notes yielded 7.17 percent. -- Hong Kong News Room (852) 2843 6369
